title: Entity behavior
responsibility: Reads recorded behavior artifacts and presents current or compared end-to-end results with entity reasons.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.behavior
inputs.description: Required metadata for recorded rows before their contents are read. Row before/after hashes form the identity used to retain a completed reading.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.read
inputs.description: Optional already-read behavior, default null. Non-null bypasses local reading; null means no preloaded result and does not itself indicate failure.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.scope
inputs.description: Required mode, commit and parent context. Paired panes require commit behavior with a parent.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required base used by the artifact-reading helper and passed to run panels.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.nav
inputs.description: Required route context and navigation callbacks for full tests and selected-commit links.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.reasons
inputs.description: Optional entity change reasons, displayed separately from test observations. Their behavior summary takes precedence over derived comparison explanation.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.duration
inputs.description: Optional displayed end-to-end duration, defaulting to Not measured; the component does not calculate it.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier passed to run/artifact case rendering.

outputs.name: EntityBehavior
outputs.description: Current or before/after test panel. Reads artifacts when not supplied, ignores completion whose row-hash signature no longer matches, and shows pending or unknown rather than premature comparison. Missing groups are explicit. Shows scenario outcomes, duration, original reasons and navigation. A passing current/unchanged verdict is shown only when the helper also reports passing results.
